spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (तलति तालयति)
1 To be full or complete.
2 To fix, to found.
3 To establish.

n. (-लं)
1 Essential nature, (in composition especially, as महीतलं the earth itself, the very earth.)
2 Depth, bottom, lowness, inferiority of position, the place under or underneath.
3 A wood, a forest.
4 A hole, a pit, a chasm.
5 Cause, origin, motive, the root or seed of events.
6 Sole of the foot.
7 A slap with the hand.
nf. (-लं-ला)
A leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm.
m. (-लः)
1 The palmyra tree.
2 The palm with extended fingers.
3 The hilt or handle of a sword, &c.
4 Pressing the strings of a lute with the left hand.
3 The stand or support of any thing, that which is under or below it.
6 The fore arm.
7 A span.
E.
तल to fix, affix अच्.

m. (-ल्लः)
A reservoir, a large pond, a tank or Talao.
f. (-ल्ला)
1 A young woman.
2 A boat.
3 The wife of VARUṆA.
n. (-ल्लं)
A pit, a hole.
E.
तल deep, depth, and ल to be or have, from ला with ड aff.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Made of the palm wood.
m. (-लः)
1 Beating time in music, musical time or measure.
2 A short span, one measured by the thumb and middle finger.
3 Slapping or clapping the hands together, or against the arms, &c.
4 The open hand with the fingers extended, the palm.
5 A musical instrument of bell metal or brass, (a sort of cymbal,) played with a stick.
6 The hilt of a sword or sacrificial knife, &c.
7 The palmyra tree or fan palm, (Borassus flabelliformis.)
8 A lock, a bolt.
9 In prosody, a trochee.
n. (-लं)
1 The throne of

DURGĀ.
2

Yellow orpiment: see हरिताल.
3 The fruit of the palm tree.
f. (-ली)
1 A sort of key or pin.
2 A species of the mountain palm, (Corypha taliera, Rox.)
3 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta): see झटा and अमला.
4 A fragrant earth: see तुवरिका.
5 A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.)
6 The spirituous juice of the palm, the common Toddy.
E.
तल to fix or तन to spread, affix घञ्; or in the causal form, with अच् affix, fem. affix ङीष्, न changed to ल; otherwise, तड to beat, to overcome, (disease, &c.) अच् and ङीष् affixes, and ड changed to ल; the adjective is derived from the substantive by adding अण्.

n. (-कं)
A large pond.
E.
तल a hole, a hollow, and कन् aff.

n. (-कं)
1 A bolt, a latch, a kind of lock for fastening a door with.
2 Yellow orpiment.
3 A fragrant earth.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
A slap or blow with the palm of the hand.
E.
तल the open palm, प्रहार striking.

n. (-णं)
A sword.
E.
तल, and वारण opposing.

n. (-कं)
1 A martingale.
2 A vessel from which horses are fed.
E.
तल below, सृ to go, in the causal form, वुन् aff.

n. (-यं)
The centre of the sole of the foot.
E.
तल below, and हृदय heart.

f. (-ची)
A mat, one made of reeds or bamboos.
E.
तल below, अञ्च to go, क्विप् affix, fem. form.

n. (-लं)
One of the seven divisions of the infernal regions.
E.
तल below, reiterated, as downadown.

f. (-का)
A martingale.
E.
तल to fix, and वुन् aff.

f. (-का)
A key.

mf. (-कः-का)
The open palm of the hand.
m. (-कः)
A tie, a seal, a string, &c. binding a letter or parcel of papers.
f. (-का)
A plant: see तालमूली.
E.
ताल as above, and कन् affix.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fixed, placed, having a bottom.
n. (-तं)
Fried meat.
E.
तल to be fixed or to satisfy, क्त aff.

n. (-तं)
1 Any musical instrument.
2 Dyed or coloured cloth.
3 A string, a tie.
E.
ताल musical time, &c. इतच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Separate, having spaces or interstices.
2 Clear, clean.
3 Small, little.
4 Delicate, thin, spare.
5 Below, situated under or underneath.
n. (-नं)
A bed, a couch or cot.
E.
तल to fix or be fixed, Uṇādi affix इनन्.

n. (-मं)
1 Ground prepared for the site of a dwelling, &c. see कुट्टिम.
2 A bed, a couch or cot.
3 An awning.
4 A scymitar, a large sacrificial sword or knife.
E.
तल to fix, इमन् aff.

m. (-नः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A youth.
f. (-नी)
A young woman.
E.
तॄ to pass, उनन् affix, and र changed to लः see तरुण.

m. (-णः)
A hog.
E.
तल down, and ईक्षण looking.

f. (-री)
A mistress or wife.

f. (-दा)
A river.
E.
तल steep, down, उद water.

n. (-ल्कं)
A wood, a forest.
E.
तल to fix, क Uṇādi aff.

mn. (-ल्पः-ल्पं)
1 A bed.
2 An upper story, a room on the top of a house, a turret, a tower or keep.
3 A wife.
E.
तल to fix, Uṇādi affix प.

m. (-टः)
A bug.
E.
तल्प a bed, and कीट an insect.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Born of a wife, (as a son by an appointed substitute.)
2 Produced in or from a bed, &c.
E.
तल्प, and ज born.

n. (-नं)
An elephant's back.
2 The exterior muscles of the back.
E.
तल्प a nominal verb, to be as a bed, to be broad, &c. and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-जः)
Excellence, happiness; also attributively, Excellent, happy: used in apposition as an epithet, the gender is not changed, as कुमारीतल्लजः an excellent maiden.
E.
तत् that, (that which is every thing,) and लज to attain, affix अच्.

n. (-ल्वं)
Scent arising from the rubbing of fragrant substances.

adj. mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Green.
m. (-भः)
Green, the colour.
E.
तालक yellow orpiment, and आभ what resembles.

f. (-की)
Toddy, or the fermented exudation of the palm trees.
E.
ताल the palmyra, कन् aff.

f. (-टा)
The fibres of the palm tree under the outer bark.
E.
ताल, and जटा matted hair.

m. (-जः)
A name of BALARĀMA.
f. (-जा)
The name of a city.
E.
ताल the palm, and ध्वज a banner.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A hollow cylinder of gold with or without a ring attached to it, thrust through the lobe of the ear, and worn as an ornament.
2 The palm leaf.
E.
ताल the palmyra, and पत्र a leaf, pieces of the leaf of this tree being rolled up and used occasionally for the purpose or as a substitute.
f. (-त्री)
A plant: see मूषिकपर्णी.
E.
as above; the leaves resembling those of the palm tree, or the palm of the hand.

nf. (-र्णं-र्णी)
1 A kind of vegetable perfume: see मुरा.
f. (-र्णी)
A sort of anise, (Anethum pammorium, Rox.)
E.
ताल the palm, and पर्ण a leaf, palm-leaved.

n. (-कं)
A medicinal application to the eyes.
E.
ताल the palmyra, पुष्प a flower, and कन् affix; perhaps prepared from the blossoms of the palmyra.

n. (-म्वं)
The fibres that grow on the cocoanut and other palms, under the outer rind, and from which Coir, a sort of cordage, is prepared.
E.
ताल, and प्रलम्व what depends.

m. (-भृत्)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
तास्व the palm, and भृत् who retains, (as his banner or symbol): see तालध्वज, &c.

mn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of the palm, &c.
E.
ताल, and मयट् aff.

f. (-ली)
A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.)
E.
ताल the palm, and मूल a root, having a similar root; also with कन् added तालमूलिका f. (-का).

n. (-न्त्रं)
1 A lock, a lock and key.
2 A small pair of pincers.
E.
ताल, and यन्त्र instrument.

m. (-क्ष्मा)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
ताल, and लक्ष्मन् a mark or sign: see तालध्वज.

m. (-न्तः)
A fan.
E.
ताल the palm of the hand, and वृन्त a root-stalk; expanding from the hand like a leaf from its stem; also with कन् added तालवृन्तक.

n. (-कं)
A fan, a Pankha: see the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A dancer, an actor.
E.
ताल musical tone, विच to observe, ल्यु affix, तालवेचन and कन् pleonasm added; also read तालरेचनक.

f. (-ख्या)
A perfume: see मुरा.
E.
ताल, the palmyra, and आख्या a name.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 A name of

BALARĀMA.
2

A saw.
3 A book.
4 A name of Ś

IVA.
5

A man marked with every fortunate spot or sign, &c.
6 A sort of vegetable.
E.
ताल the tree, and अङ्क mark or emblem.

m. (-रः)
A dancer, an actor.
E.
ताल musical time, अवचर to follow or perform, to affix अच्.

f. (-लिः)
A kind of palm, (Corypha taliera): see ताली.

m. (-शः)
A mountain.
E.
ताल to be fixed, इश Uṇādi affix, the radical vowel made long.

n. (शं)
A tree, commonly Tālīśa or its leaf.
E.
ताल the corypha, ईश what resembles.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
2 A tree, Tāliśa or its leaf, which is used in medicine.
E.
तालीश as above, and पत्र a leaf.

n. (-लु)
The palate.
E.
तॄ to pass, to go, Uṇādi affix, ञुण्; by which words, &c. proceed.

f. (-का)
The palate.
E.
तालु, and कन् added.

m. (-ह्वः)
1 The uvula.
2 A crocodile.
E.
तालु the palate, and जिह्वा the tongue.

m. (-टः)
An indolent swelling of the palate.

m. (-रः)
A whirlpool, an eddy.
E.
तल to be deep, उरन् affix; also read तालुर.
